title: Transport of the actual diagonal completion coefficient map
statement: For a prime l, any scheme S, and the arbitrary derived localizations in [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-models], let J be the equivalent AsSmall pro-etale topology, A=ULift Z_l and I=(l). There are derived-category equivalences EB from actual completed-coefficient modules to ConstantCompletion.D(completed J A I), and ER from constant Z_l-module sheaves to ConstantCompletion.D(constant J A), with additive ER and inverse, and a natural isomorphism diagonalCompletedUnderlying(l,S) ⋙ ER.functor ≅ EB.functor ⋙ ConstantCompletion.dres(coefficientMap J A I). This compares the actual scalar functors and imposes no completeness predicate.

proof.text: Transport both coefficient categories by precomposition with the AsSmall equivalence of the pro-etale site, and identify constant-ring module sheaves with sheaves valued in modules over the coefficient ring. These are exact additive equivalences.

The surjective residue map Z_l → Z/l^(n+1) has kernel (l^(n+1)). Its quotient isomorphisms, lifted to the coefficient universe and constant sheafified, commute with every quotient transition. Precomposition along the small-site equivalence commutes with sheafification and limits. Construct these comparison isomorphisms directly for the quotient tower. Their projection equations identify the actual completed ring with ConstantCompletion.completed and identify the constant-to-completed coefficient map itself.

The scalar-restriction square is naturally the identity on underlying sections. Exact derived functor localization carries this natural isomorphism and the two abelian equivalences through the arbitrary chosen derived localizations. This proves the stated natural isomorphism, not merely abstract equivalence of the source and target categories.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalCompletionCoefficientTransport (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (S : Scheme.{u})
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S] :
    let J := Scheme.proEtaleModelTopology S
    let A := ULift.{u + 1} ℤ_[l]
    let I : Ideal A := Ideal.span {(l : A)}
    ∃ (EB : DerivedCategory (DiagonalCompleted l S) ≌
          ConstantCompletion.D (ConstantCompletion.completed J A I))
      (ER : DerivedCategory (DiagonalMod l S) ≌
          ConstantCompletion.D (ConstantCompletion.constant J A)),
      ER.functor.Additive ∧ ER.inverse.Additive ∧
      Nonempty (diagonalCompletedUnderlying l S ⋙ ER.functor ≅
        EB.functor ⋙ ConstantCompletion.dres (ConstantCompletion.coefficientMap J A I))
